subject.facility_name: NOTRE DAME HEALTH AND REHABILITATION CENTER

executive_summary.text: PBJ-based estimate was below the Connecticut total direct-care comparison point in 1 quarter(s): 2024Q4.
Current operational/managerial control reported to CMS: DANA PAUL (since 04/02/2013).
Cost year 2025: related party disclosed as "Congregation - St. Thomas of Villanova," for Administrative Nun Service, cost reported $85,731 (16 / m11).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $603,840, of which $194,914 is counted in direct care.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 11 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $39,230 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Professional Care Of Residents (page 10 line A12o), removed $90,139; Other Administrative Salaries (page 10 line A4), added $76,305; Medical Director (page 13 line B8a), removed $15,876. Separately, the home itself removed $186,068 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.
CMS lists 26 health citations for this home between 2019-01-14 and 2026-09-02, including 1 at actual harm or immediate jeopardy level (0 immediate jeopardy).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: No current ownership-interest records are listed for this home in CMS All Owners (common for nonprofits, which list directors and officers instead). Confirm the licensee with DPH.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
